failure_patterns: bcrypt 5.x + Python 3.12: use bcrypt directly, not passlib
container_files + container_revisions: circular FK requires no-FK on one side
FastAPI HTTPBearer: get_current_user raises 401 credentials_exception — POST /api/v1/workflows without auth returns 401, not 403. Assert 401 in E2E tests.
success_patterns: SELECT FOR UPDATE for concurrent approval race condition prevention
Chunk-based streaming upload to enforce size limit before full load
Look-ahead algorithm for optional segment skipping in naming validator
NamingRule dataclass designed for DI — DB model stores JSON, service converts to dataclass
react-refresh/only-export-components: move non-component exports to lib/fmt.ts
Playwright E2E mock-mode: use real authenticate() helper (live backend always up in CI) — mock tokens trigger api.ts 401 interceptor and redirect to /login
